scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --no-proxy-headers --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
scripts.test:api: cd services/api && PYTHONPATH=.:../job-worker uv run pytest -q
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/job-worker && PYTHONPATH=../api:. uv run --project ../api python main.py
scripts.dev:scheduler: cd services/scheduler && PYTHONPATH=../api uv run --project ../api python main.py
scripts.dev:feishu: cd services/feishu && PYTHONPATH=../api:. uv run --project ../api python main.py
scripts.dev:stack: echo 'Run in terminals: pnpm dev:api | pnpm dev:worker | pnpm dev:agent-worker | pnpm dev:web | pnpm dev:feishu | pnpm dev:scheduler'
scripts.test:gates: cd services/api && PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_gates.py tests/test_gates_extended.py tests/test_gates_facade.py tests/test_gates_legacy_contract.py tests/test_gates_boundary_contract.py tests/test_gate_bridge.py tests/test_scene_count.py
